verdict.rationale: Docs show LiteLLM Router can load-balance calls across multiple deployments/keys (e.g., multiple Azure/OpenAI endpoints) and supports per-team/key rpm_limit and retry/fallback logic on failure, which together enable spreading load and softening rate-limit hits. However, there is no explicit evidence of a request queue or throttling mechanism beyond retries/fallbacks, so the queuing/throttling half of the story is only partially substantiated.
